parent.successor_rule: Reproduce the accepted parent exactly, freeze every parent parameter, then train only successor-owned transition-trace residual parameters.

fresh_isolation.rule: No fresh:40..79 task may be instantiated by successor training or development code before a separately frozen candidate passes reproducibility and receives PRE_FRESH_LOCK authority.

architecture.parent_policy: accepted Neural vNext Native recurrent policy, frozen
architecture.trace_recurrent: GRUCell over ordered public transition tokens with exact padding masks
architecture.residual_policy: shared per-action residual scorer over parent action token + parent recurrent hidden + trace hidden
architecture.residual_initialization: zero final layer, making initialization exactly parent-equivalent

transition_token.source: public before/after observations plus public step result only

training.teacher: same public-exploration-first then FIGG-18 train-only oracle target as accepted parent
selection_rule: candidate must solve strictly more development episodes than the frozen parent on dev:32..63
candidate may regress no family by more than 2 solved episodes versus parent
candidate must improve at least one of regime_switch or implicit_goal_regimes
among eligible candidates maximize development solved episodes
then maximize minimum family solved episodes

claim_boundary: R2 is a new successor candidate, not a mutation of the accepted parent. Development uses a new dev block and future promotion must use fresh:40..79. Accepted parent authority and fresh:0..39 remain immutable.
